## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Sachsen lights up on the map of Germany.
> Sachsen | Landeshauptstadt Dresden

[dramatic] [[Sachsen]], Saxony, in the east, is a Freistaat, like Bavaria. Its capital is Dresden, and its biggest city is Leipzig, where the Monday demonstrations of 1989 began.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Saxony, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> SACHSEN

## On the map

{Q428}

> SCENE (question): Question card #428. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Sachsen?]] Which federal state is Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[4]]. Number four: the east, on the borders with Poland and the Czech Republic.


{Q427}

> SCENE (question): Question card #427. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Sachsen heißt …]] The state capital of Saxony is …

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Dresden.]] The other three are real cities in Saxony, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q425}

> SCENE (question): Question card #425. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Sachsen?]] What colors are on the state flag of Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[weiß-grün]]. White and green.


{Q421}

> SCENE (question): Question card #421. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Freistaat Sachsen?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the Free State of Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 4]], picture four: black and gold stripes, with a green band of leaves across them.


## How it's run

{Q422}

> SCENE (question): Question card #422. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Sachsen?]] Which of these is a district in Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Vogtlandkreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], [[Uckermark]] is in [[Brandenburg]], and [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]].


{Q423}

> SCENE (question): Question card #423. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Sachsen gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament (Landtag) in Saxony elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q424}

> SCENE (question): Question card #424. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Sachsen bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] At what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[18]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from eighteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q429}

> SCENE (question): Question card #429. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Sachsen?]] What is the head of government in Saxony called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q430}

> SCENE (question): Question card #430. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Sachsen nicht?]] Which minister does Saxony not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q426}

> SCENE (question): Question card #426. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Sachsen über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Saxony?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Dresden, weiß-grün, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Dresden]]. [[weiß-grün]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
